versions.changelog:
adam-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of Adam Daily Life Manager.
- Features include schedule management, to-do organization, shopping and meal planning, appointment tracking, and routine planning.
- Supports personal, family, and household coordination.
- Offers productivity tools, reminders, checklists, and prioritization support.
- Designed as an all-in-one assistant for efficient life organization and decision-making.
